==Description==
'''Tackle''' will be a entity that you will easily find in the [[Unnamed Sector]], rarely after 500, and anytime in [[Super Epic Mode]]

==Mechanics==
When '''Tackle''' spawns, it will rush to the door then it will rebound, then it will make a sound of rebound alert from [[D-60]] then rebound again, it will repeat this at maximum 5 then despawn.

==Strategies==
When you hear its spawn cue, hide, when he goes a bit far leave the locker and enter again once you hear the [[D-60]]'s rebound alert sound

==Trivia==
* '''Tackle's''' old face is '''Tackle''' face from Doors Hardcore Mode
